title: Vernon Kwek meeting with BATU, e2i and LHUB
summary: With Vernon Kwek’s vision for all of our team members, Primech have signed an MOU with BATU, e2i and LHub to form a Company Training Committee (CTC). This programme allows workers to have better job prospects by being ready for new technology and business models.
body_markdown: With Vernon Kwek’s vision for all of our team members, Primech have signed an MOU with BATU, e2i and LHub to form a Company Training Committee (CTC). This programme allows workers to have better job prospects by being ready for new technology and business models.
